description:
The #693 disk-headroom gate is trivially bypassable, verified on develop
@ fc31f3604:

1. PHASE-LIST KEYING: every mid-run free-space check is keyed on
   `"preflight" in config.phases` -- orchestrator.py:295
   (free_space_checks_enabled), :299 (watch_disk_floor), _cli.py:419.
   An execute-only config (a legitimate composition the schema allows)
   runs with ZERO disk gating. Omitting a phase named "preflight" should
   skip the preflight REPORT, not disable a safety interlock.

2. SILENT DEGRADE: `except Exception` at tests/uat/phases/preflight.py:217
   downgrades any failure inside estimate_disk_budget_summary_and_gate to
   a warning; budget_gate stays None and the stronger budget-aware gate
   silently falls back to the flat free_space_min_gib cutoff
   (preflight.py:227-238). A bug in the estimator disables the gate it
   feeds with only a stderr line.

3. EXPLICIT-ZERO SEMANTICS: free_space_min_gib <= 0 disables all checks
   (execute.py:691-692) with no acknowledgement that a safety gate is off.

Desired end state: the free-space floor and per-cell disk watch are
active for every execute-bearing run regardless of the phases list;
`free_space_min_gib: 0` remains the documented opt-out but logs a loud
one-line warning; an estimator failure is a hard preflight error (the
operator fixes the budget table or sets the flat floor explicitly),
not a silent downgrade.

anti_patterns.dont: gate the per-cell watch on any phase-name membership check
anti_patterns.why: that is the bug class being removed.

anti_patterns.dont: let the estimator hard-fail bury WHICH table row/parse step failed; surface the underlying exception message.

deferrals.reason: Needs per-cell size prediction; the advisory budget table is (platform, benchmark, scale)-keyed and could feed this, but prediction accuracy work is out of scope for a gate-wiring fix.
deferrals.summary: Pre-cell (predictive) disk check so one oversized cell cannot fill the disk before the post-cell watch fires

preserves.behavior: Abort semantics: disk-floor breach still produces a structured abort with docker teardown guaranteed (execute.py finally) and abort-safe artifacts.
The advisory disk-budget ESTIMATE remains advisory (never gates on unknown cells); only estimator CRASHES become errors.
preflight_budget.py max(flat floor, budget est) resolution logic unchanged.

prior_art.concept: tests/uat/orchestrator.py:141-162 _build_disk_floor_runner -- the per-cell watch mechanism; this TODO changes when it is installed, not how it works. Reuse.
tests/uat/preflight_budget.py -- the budget-vs-floor max() logic (preflight_budget.py:183-196) stays canonical. Reuse.

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/uat/test_orchestrator.py tests/uat/test_preflight.py tests/uat/test_preflight_budget.py -q
verifications.description: Bypass regression: execute-only config aborts on a mocked low-disk condition
verifications.expected: pass, including new always-on and estimator-failure tests

work_units.notes: Added `UATConfig.disk_gate_enabled` property (config.py, resolved floor > 0). orchestrator.py's execute-phase kwargs (`free_space_checks_enabled`, `watch_disk_floor` fed into `_build_disk_floor_runner`) and _cli.py's `_handle_execute` `free_space_checks_enabled` kwarg now consume it instead of `"preflight" in config.phases`. The `if phase == "preflight":` / `if "preflight" in config.phases:` blocks that own the pre-sweep report/abort are unchanged -- only the two keying sites that gated a safety interlock were replaced.
work_units.summary: Replace the phase-list keying in orchestrator.py and _cli.py with an always-on default driven by the resolved floor; the preflight phase keeps owning only the pre-sweep report/abort

work_units.notes: Config-load validation already allowed exactly 0 via `_require_nonnegative_float` (negatives rejected) -- no schema change needed. Added `config.disk_gate_disabled_warning()` printed to stderr at the top of `run_sweep` (when `"execute" in config.phases` and not dry_run) and at the top of `_cli._handle_execute`. Threaded a new `disk_gate_disabled` bool through `orchestrator._write_cells_jsonl` into the `cells.jsonl.accounting.json` sidecar (additive field; existing readers key only on `skipped_unreachable_count`).
work_units.summary: free_space_min_gib: 0 emits a prominent 'disk gate DISABLED by config' warning at sweep start and records disk_gate_disabled=true in the accounting sidecar

work_units.notes: Narrowed the `except Exception` around `estimate_disk_budget_summary_and_gate` to `(OSError, ValueError, KeyError)`. On catch, `run_preflight` now returns immediately with `aborted=True` and `abort_reason=f"disk budget estimator failed: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"` instead of appending a warning and falling through to the flat-cutoff path. `unknown_cells` (missing table rows) is unchanged -- still advisory, still a warning, never a gate. Updated the old warn-and-continue test (test_preflight_disk_budget_table_error_is_advisory -> test_preflight_disk_budget_table_error_hard_fails_preflight) and added test_preflight_disk_budget_unexpected_error_propagates to pin that a genuinely unexpected exception type is NOT swallowed.
work_units.summary: Narrow preflight.py:217 to expected error types; estimator failures fail preflight with the underlying error instead of silently degrading to the flat cutoff

work_units.notes: Added to test_orchestrator.py: test_execute_only_config_still_gets_disk_floor_watch (phases=["execute"], mocked low disk -> aborted_phase == "execute") and test_zero_floor_warns_loudly_and_flags_accounting_sidecar (free_space_min_gib=0 -> stderr warning + accounting sidecar disk_gate_disabled=true). Added to test_preflight.py: the w3 tests above. Updated test_cli_dispatch.py's test_execute_main_reads_cleanup_config_for_standalone_path (free_space_checks_enabled expectation False -> True for an execute-only config, since the disk gate no longer depends on "preflight" being in phases).
work_units.summary: Regression tests: execute-only config still gets the per-cell watch; estimator exception fails preflight; zero-floor warning + sidecar flag asserted
